yaml:
id: dex-list
version: 0.1.0
description: >
  DEX token lists, launchpads and wallets: badge or hide a token. Lighter than
  cex-standard and plannable on today's intents (holder count in place of
  top-10 concentration). Draft thresholds.
blockers:
  - { check: sanctions, status: FAIL }
  - { check: contract_audit, status: FAIL, minSeverity: 3 }
required: [contract_audit, sanctions, liquidity_depth, holder_count]
optional: [wash_trading, social_bots]
thresholds:
  liquidity_depth: { warn: 100000, fail: 20000, field: liquidity_usd }
  holder_count: { warn: 300, fail: 50, field: holders_count }
  wash_trading: { warn: 25, fail: 60, field: wash_volume_pct }
weights: { contract_audit: 0.35, liquidity_depth: 0.25, holder_count: 0.15,
           wash_trading: 0.15, social_bots: 0.10 }
conflicts:
  - code: MARKET_INTEGRITY_CONFLICT
    detail: audit PASS but wash_trading FAIL
    when: [{ check: contract_audit, status: PASS }, { check: wash_trading, status: FAIL }]
decision:
  approve_below_risk_bps: 3000
  reject_above_risk_bps: 7000
  min_coverage: 0.75
  min_confidence: 0.55
  conflict_escalates: true
  abstain_on_missing_required: true
  required_fail_blocks_approve: true
  agreement_penalty: 0.25
scoring:
  status_risk: { PASS: 0, WARN: 0.5, FAIL: 1 }
  severity_multiplier: [0.6, 0.8, 1.0, 1.0]
budget: { max_usdc: 0.12, per_check_timeout_ms: { contract_audit: 16000, default: 4000 } }
